Definition: a boil or ulcer (from the inflammation), especially a tumor in the anus or pudenda (the piles)
BiblicalUsage: The word is the emerods, the tumours with which God smote the Philistines. The hand of the Lord was heavy upon them of Ashdod, and He smote them with emerods; the priests said to send five golden emerods, one for each lord of the Philistines; and the law warns that disobedience will bring the emerods of Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the tumours on Ashdod were God's handwriting, and the Philistines read it and sent the ark back.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
